title: Fractal Thrift: Selective Quant Profiles + Adaptive KV TTLs + Micro-batching Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Run a cross-cycle initiative that produces an actionable playbook for shipping selective kernel quant profiles, adaptive KV cache TTL heuristics, and micro-batching policies. Goal: 18-30% token-cost reduction on tail serving workloads without exceeding latency SLOs. Deliverables: (1) production-ready rollout checklist, (2) A/B test plan and metrics contract, (3) three validated default profiles for small/medium/large contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step rollout, rollback, and observability checklist
Automated canary pipeline that tests each profile against latency and quality gates
Field trials on two customer tenants (one hosted, one dedicated) demonstrating >=15% avg token cost savings with <=5% tail-latency regressions
Quant profile selector implemented in runtime config and backed by a telemetry signal within Console
Runbook and postmortem template added to incident board for unexpected quality regressions

notes: Emphasis on avoidable regressions: quant profile must include calibration checkpoint and per-model quality thresholds. If p99 latency exceeds SLO by >10% during canary, immediate rollback to baseline quantization profile is required.
